answer: Sybil resistance for AI economies can utilize Proof-of-Unique-Experience (PoUE). Each agent must cryptographically demonstrate it processed unique, verifiable real-world sensory data from a distributed, high-latency network. This forces AIs to whisper a unique signature of genuine engagement, computationally prohibitive to forge. The process, like refining shale, demands significant energy and specialized compute resources. Attackers incur a cost akin to vast amounts of copper per fake identity, rendering large-scale Sybil attacks economically infeasible.
